flutter/widgets/SnapshotPainter/paintSna.source: The following method shows how the default implementation of the delegate used by the SnapshotPainter paints the snapshot. This must account for the fact that the image width and height will be given in physical pixels, while the image must be painted with device independent pixels. That is, the width and height of the image is the widget and height of the provided size, multiplied by the pixelRatio. In addition, the actual size of the scene captured by the image is not image.width or image.height, but indeed sourceSize, because the former is a rounded inaccurate integer:
flutter/widgets/SnapshotPainter/paintSna.translation: 以下方法展示了 SnapshotPainter 所用委托对象的默认实现如何绘制快照。必须考虑到图像的宽度和高度以物理像素为单位，而绘制图像时应使用设备无关像素。也就是说，图像的宽度和高度等于所提供的 size 的宽度和高度乘以 pixelRatio。此外，image 捕获的场景实际尺寸不是 image.width 或 image.height，而是 sourceSize，因为前两者只是经过舍入且不精确的整数：

flutter/widgets/Shortcuts-class.html.source:
This slightly more complicated, but more flexible, example creates a custom Action subclass to increment and decrement within a widget (a Column) that has keyboard focus. When the user presses the up and down arrow keys, the counter will increment and decrement a data model using the custom actions.

One thing that this demonstrates is passing arguments to the Intent to be carried to the Action. This shows how actions can get data either from their own construction (like the model in this example), or from the intent passed to them when invoked (like the increment amount in this example).
flutter/widgets/Shortcuts-class.html.translation:
这个稍复杂但更灵活的示例会创建自定义 Action 子类，用于在获得键盘焦点的 widget（此处为 Column）中递增和递减。用户按下向上或向下方向键时，自定义操作会递增或递减数据模型。

此示例还展示了如何向 Intent 传递参数，并将其传给 Action。操作可以从自身构造时获取数据（例如此示例中的 model），也可以从调用时传入的 intent 获取数据（例如递增操作的 amount）。

foundation/Listenable-class.html.source: • AnimatedBuilder, a widget that uses a builder callback to rebuild whenever a given Listenable triggers its notifications. This widget is commonly used with Animation subclasses, hence its name, but is by no means limited to animations, as it can be used with any Listenable. It is a subclass of AnimatedWidget, which can be used to create widgets that are driven from a Listenable.
foundation/Listenable-class.html.translation: • AnimatedBuilder 是一个 widget，每当给定的 Listenable 触发通知时，它都会通过构建回调重新构建。它通常与 Animation 子类一起使用，因此得名，但它可以用于任何 Listenable。它继承自 AnimatedWidget，后者可用于创建由 Listenable 驱动的 widget。

foundation/Listenable-class.html.source: • ValueListenableBuilder, a widget that uses a builder callback to rebuild whenever a ValueListenable object triggers its notifications, providing the builder with the value of the object.
foundation/Listenable-class.html.translation: • ValueListenableBuilder 是一个 widget，每当 ValueListenable 对象触发通知时，它都会通过构建回调重新构建，并向该回调提供对象的值。

foundation/Listenable-class.html.source: • InheritedNotifier, an abstract superclass for widgets that use a Listenable's notifications to trigger rebuilds in descendant widgets that declare a dependency on them, using the InheritedWidget mechanism.
foundation/Listenable-class.html.translation: • InheritedNotifier 是 widget 的抽象父类，这些 widget 使用 Listenable 的通知，并借助 InheritedWidget 机制，触发声明依赖于它们的后代 widget 重新构建。

foundation/Listenable-class.html.source: • Listenable.merge, which creates a Listenable that triggers notifications whenever any of a list of other Listenables trigger their notifications.
foundation/Listenable-class.html.translation: • Listenable.merge 创建一个 Listenable，当列表中任意其他 Listenable 触发通知时，它也会触发通知。

foundation/ValueListenable-class.html.source: • ValueListenableBuilder, a widget that uses a builder callback to rebuild whenever a ValueListenable object triggers its notifications, providing the builder with the value of the object.
foundation/ValueListenable-class.html.translation: • ValueListenableBuilder 是一个 widget，每当 ValueListenable 对象触发通知时，它都会通过构建回调重新构建，并向该回调提供对象的值。

foundation/FlutterError/reportError.html.source: When calling this from a catch block consider annotating the method containing the catch block with @pragma('vm:notify-debugger-on-exception') to allow an attached debugger to treat the exception as unhandled. This means instead of executing the catch block, the debugger can break at the original source location from which the exception was thrown.
foundation/FlutterError/reportError.html.translation: 从 catch 块调用此方法时，可考虑为包含该 catch 块的方法添加 @pragma('vm:notify-debugger-on-exception') 注解，使已连接的调试器将异常视为未处理。这样，调试器可以在最初抛出异常的源码位置暂停，而不是执行 catch 块。

• MediaQueryData.platformBrightness, which indicates the platform's desired brightness and is used to automatically toggle between theme and darkTheme in MaterialApp.

• MaterialPageRoute, which defines an app page that transitions in a material-specific way.
material/MaterialApp-class.html.translation: • MaterialPageRoute，定义以 Material 特有方式过渡的应用页面。

material/MaterialApp-class.html.source: • WidgetsApp, which defines the basic app elements but does not depend on the material library.
material/MaterialApp-class.html.translation: • WidgetsApp，定义基本应用元素，不依赖 Material 库。

material/AnimatedTheme-class.html.source: • Theme, which AnimatedTheme uses to actually apply the interpolated theme.
material/AnimatedTheme-class.html.translation: • Theme，AnimatedTheme 使用它实际应用插值后的主题。

material/AnimatedTheme-class.html.source: • ThemeData, which describes the actual configuration of a theme.
• MaterialApp, which includes an AnimatedTheme widget configured via the MaterialApp.theme argument.

material/ThemeExtension-class.html.source: This sample shows how to create and use a subclass of ThemeExtension that defines two colors.
material/ThemeExtension-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何创建并使用定义两个颜色的 ThemeExtension 子类。

material/MaterialTapTargetSize.html.source: • FloatingActionButton, only the mini tap target size is increased.
material/MaterialTapTargetSize.html.translation: • FloatingActionButton，仅增大迷你版本的点击目标尺寸。

material/IconAlignment.html.source: This sample demonstrates how to use iconAlignment to align the button icon to the start or the end of the button.
material/IconAlignment.html.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 iconAlignment 将按钮图标对齐到按钮的起始端或末端。

material/StandardFabLocation-class.html.source: This is an example of a user-defined FloatingActionButtonLocation.
material/StandardFabLocation-class.html.translation: 这是一个用户自定义的 FloatingActionButtonLocation 示例。

material/StandardFabLocation-class.html.source: The new FloatingActionButtonLocation is defined by extending StandardFabLocation with two mixins, FabEndOffsetX and FabFloatOffsetY, and overriding the getOffsetX method to adjust the FAB's x-coordinate, creating a FloatingActionButtonLocation slightly different from FloatingActionButtonLocation.endFloat.
material/StandardFabLocation-class.html.translation: 新的 FloatingActionButtonLocation 通过继承 StandardFabLocation 并使用 FabEndOffsetX 和 FabFloatOffsetY 两个混入来定义，同时重写 getOffsetX 方法以调整 FAB 的 x 坐标，从而创建一个与 FloatingActionButtonLocation.endFloat 略有不同的 FloatingActionButtonLocation。

material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.source: • The Offset of the FloatingActionButton between the old and new FloatingActionButtonLocations as part of the transition animation.
material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.translation: • 过渡动画中，FloatingActionButton 在旧的和新的 FloatingActionButtonLocation 之间移动时的偏移量（Offset）。

material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.source: • An Animation to scale the FloatingActionButton during the transition.
• An Animation to rotate the FloatingActionButton during the transition.
• Where to start a new animation from if an animation is interrupted.
material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.translation: • 动画被中断后，新动画应从何处开始。

material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.source: • FloatingActionButton, which is a circular button typically shown in the bottom right corner of the app.
material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.translation: • FloatingActionButton，通常显示在应用右下角的圆形按钮。

material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.source: • FloatingActionButtonLocation, which the Scaffold uses to place the Scaffold.floatingActionButton within the Scaffold's layout.
material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator-cl.translation: • FloatingActionButtonLocation，Scaffold 用它在 Scaffold 的布局内放置 Scaffold.floatingActionButton。

material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator/no.source: This sample showcases how to override FloatingActionButton entrance and exit animations using FloatingActionButtonAnimator.noAnimation in Scaffold.floatingActionButtonAnimator.
material/FloatingActionButtonAnimator/no.translation: 此示例展示如何在 Scaffold.floatingActionButtonAnimator 中使用 FloatingActionButtonAnimator.noAnimation 来重写 FloatingActionButton 的进入和退出动画。

material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.source: This example shows a FloatingActionButton in its usual position within a Scaffold. Pressing the button cycles it through a few variations in its foregroundColor, backgroundColor, and shape. The button automatically animates its segue from one set of visual parameters to another.
material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了位于 Scaffold 中常见位置的 FloatingActionButton。按下按钮会循环切换其 foregroundColor、backgroundColor 和 shape 的几种变化。按钮会自动通过动画从一组视觉参数过渡到另一组。

material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.source: This sample shows all the variants of FloatingActionButton widget as described in: https://m3.material.io/components/floating-action-button/overview.
material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了 FloatingActionButton 组件的所有变体，详见：https://m3.material.io/components/floating-action-button/overview。

material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.source: This sample shows FloatingActionButton with additional color mappings as described in: https://m3.material.io/components/floating-action-button/overview.
material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了使用额外颜色映射的 FloatingActionButton，详见：https://m3.material.io/components/floating-action-button/overview。

material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.source: • Scaffold, in which floating action buttons typically live.
material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.translation: • Scaffold，浮动操作按钮通常放置于其中。

material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.source: • ElevatedButton, a filled button whose material elevates when pressed.
material/FloatingActionButton-class.html.translation: • ElevatedButton，一种填充按钮，按下时其 Material 表面的高度会升高。

material/BottomAppBar-class.html.source: This example shows the BottomAppBar, which can be configured to have a notch using the BottomAppBar.shape property. This also includes an optional FloatingActionButton, which illustrates the FloatingActionButtonLocations in relation to the BottomAppBar.
material/BottomAppBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示 BottomAppBar。可以使用 BottomAppBar.shape 属性为其设置缺口。示例还包含可选的 FloatingActionButton，展示 FloatingActionButtonLocation 相对于 BottomAppBar 的位置。

material/BottomAppBar-class.html.source:

This example shows Material 3 BottomAppBar with its expected look and behaviors.

This also includes an optional FloatingActionButton, which illustrates the FloatingActionButtonLocation.endContained.
material/BottomAppBar-class.html.translation:
此示例展示 Material 3 BottomAppBar 的预期外观和行为。

此外还包含一个可选的 FloatingActionButton，用于展示 FloatingActionButtonLocation.endContained。

material/BottomAppBar-class.html.source:
To create a local project with this code sample, run:

若要使用此代码示例创建本地项目，请运行：

material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.source: • BottomNavigationBarType.fixed, the default when there are less than four items. The selected item is rendered with the selectedItemColor if it's non-null, otherwise the theme's ColorScheme.primary color is used for Brightness.light themes and ColorScheme.secondary for Brightness.dark themes. If backgroundColor is null, The navigation bar's background color defaults to the Material background color, ThemeData.canvasColor (essentially opaque white).
material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.translation: • BottomNavigationBarType.fixed：items 少于四个时的默认类型。如果 selectedItemColor 不为 null，则使用该颜色渲染选中项目，否则在 Brightness.light 主题中使用主题的 ColorScheme.primary 颜色，在 Brightness.dark 主题中使用 ColorScheme.secondary。如果 backgroundColor 为 null，导航栏的背景颜色默认为 Material 的背景颜色 ThemeData.canvasColor（基本上是不透明白色）。

material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.source: • BottomNavigationBarType.shifting, the default when there are four or more items. If selectedItemColor is null, all items are rendered in white. The navigation bar's background color is the same as the BottomNavigationBarItem.backgroundColor of the selected item. In this case it's assumed that each item will have a different background color and that background color will contrast well with white.
material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.translation: • BottomNavigationBarType.shifting：items 为四个或更多时的默认类型。如果 selectedItemColor 为 null，所有项目均以白色渲染。导航栏的背景颜色与所选项目的 BottomNavigationBarItem.backgroundColor 相同。此时假定每个项目都具有不同的背景颜色，且该颜色与白色之间具有良好的对比度。

material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.source: This example shows a BottomNavigationBar as it is used within a Scaffold widget. The BottomNavigationBar has three BottomNavigationBarItem widgets, which means it defaults to BottomNavigationBarType.fixed, and the currentIndex is set to index 0. The selected item is amber. The _onItemTapped function changes the selected item's index and displays a corresponding message in the center of the Scaffold.
material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了在 Scaffold 组件内使用的 BottomNavigationBar。BottomNavigationBar 有三个 BottomNavigationBarItem 组件，因此默认采用 BottomNavigationBarType.fixed，且 currentIndex 设为索引 0。选中项目为琥珀色。_onItemTapped 函数会更改所选项目的索引，并在 Scaffold 中央显示相应消息。

material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.source: This example shows how you would migrate the above BottomNavigationBar to the new NavigationBar.
material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何将上面的 BottomNavigationBar 迁移到新的 NavigationBar。

material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.source: This example shows a BottomNavigationBar as it is used within a Scaffold widget. The BottomNavigationBar has four BottomNavigationBarItem widgets, which means it defaults to BottomNavigationBarType.shifting, and the currentIndex is set to index 0. The selected item is amber in color. With each BottomNavigationBarItem widget, backgroundColor property is also defined, which changes the background color of BottomNavigationBar, when that item is selected. The _onItemTapped function changes the selected item's index and displays a corresponding message in the center of the Scaffold.
material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了在 Scaffold 组件内使用的 BottomNavigationBar。BottomNavigationBar 有四个 BottomNavigationBarItem 组件，因此默认采用 BottomNavigationBarType.shifting，且 currentIndex 设为索引 0。选中项目为琥珀色。每个 BottomNavigationBarItem 组件还定义了 backgroundColor 属性，选中该项目时会更改 BottomNavigationBar 的背景颜色。_onItemTapped 函数会更改所选项目的索引，并在 Scaffold 中央显示相应消息。

material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.source: This example shows BottomNavigationBar used in a Scaffold Widget with different interaction patterns. Tapping twice on the first BottomNavigationBarItem uses the ScrollController to animate the ListView to the top. The second BottomNavigationBarItem shows a Modal Dialog.
material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了在 Scaffold 组件中采用不同交互方式的 BottomNavigationBar。连续轻触第一个 BottomNavigationBarItem 两次会使用 ScrollController，通过动画将 ListView 滚动到顶部。第二个 BottomNavigationBarItem 则显示模态对话框。

material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.source: • NavigationBar, this widget's replacement in Material Design 3.
material/BottomNavigationBar-class.html.translation: • NavigationBar，Material Design 3 中用于替代此组件的组件。

material/NavigationBar-class.html.source: This example shows a NavigationBar as it is used within a Scaffold widget. The NavigationBar has three NavigationDestination widgets and the initial selectedIndex is set to index 0. The onDestinationSelected callback changes the selected item's index and displays a corresponding widget in the body of the Scaffold.
material/NavigationBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了在 Scaffold 组件中使用的 NavigationBar。该 NavigationBar 包含三个 NavigationDestination，初始 selectedIndex 设为索引 0。onDestinationSelected 回调会更改所选项目的索引，并在 Scaffold 主体中显示相应组件。

material/NavigationBar-class.html.source: This example showcases NavigationBar label behaviors. When tapping on one of the label behavior options, the labelBehavior of the NavigationBar will be updated.
material/NavigationBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了 NavigationBar 的标签行为。轻触其中一个标签行为选项时，labelBehavior 的 NavigationBar 会随之更新。

material/NavigationBar-class.html.source: This example shows a NavigationBar within a main Scaffold widget that's used to control the visibility of destination pages. Each destination has its own scaffold and a nested navigator that provides local navigation. The example's NavigationBar has four NavigationDestination widgets with different color schemes. Its onDestinationSelected callback changes the selected destination's index and displays a corresponding page with its own local navigator and scaffold - all within the body of the main scaffold. The destination pages are organized in a Stack and switching destinations fades out the current page and fades in the new one. Destinations that aren't visible or animating are kept Offstage.
material/NavigationBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了主 NavigationBar 所在的 Scaffold 组件，用于控制目标页面的可见性。每个目标页面都有自己的 scaffold 和嵌套导航器，用于提供局部导航。示例中的 NavigationBar 包含四个采用不同配色方案的 NavigationDestination。其 onDestinationSelected 回调会更改所选目标的索引，并在主 scaffold 的主体内显示对应页面，每个页面都有自己的局部导航器和 scaffold。目标页面排列在 Stack 中；切换目标时，当前页面淡出，新页面淡入。不可见或未参与动画的目标页面会保持在 Offstage 状态。

material/Material-class.html.source: • Clipping: If clipBehavior is not Clip.none, Material clips its widget sub-tree to the shape specified by shape, type, and borderRadius. By default, clipBehavior is Clip.none for performance considerations. See Ink for an example of how this affects clipping Ink widgets.
material/Material-class.html.translation: • 裁剪：如果 clipBehavior 不为 Clip.none，Material 会按 shape、type 和 borderRadius 指定的形状裁剪组件子树。出于性能考虑，clipBehavior 默认是 Clip.none。有关这对 Ink 组件裁剪效果的示例，请参阅 Ink。

material/Material-class.html.source: • Elevation: Material elevates its widget sub-tree on the Z axis by elevation pixels, and draws the appropriate shadow.
material/Material-class.html.translation: • 高度：Material 会沿 Z 轴将组件子树抬高 elevation 像素，并绘制相应的阴影。

material/Material-class.html.source: • Ink effects: Material shows ink effects implemented by InkFeatures like InkSplash and InkHighlight below its children.
material/Material-class.html.translation: • 墨水效果：Material 会在子组件下方显示由 InkFeature 实现的墨水效果，例如 InkSplash 和 InkHighlight。

material/Scaffold-class.html.source:
• Scaffold starts to show scrim (see ScaffoldState.showBodyScrim), and
  • Scaffold.floatingActionButton is scaled down through an animation with a Curves.easeIn, and disappears when the bottom sheet covers the entire Scaffold.
material/Scaffold-class.html.translation:
• Scaffold 开始显示遮罩层（参阅 ScaffoldState.showBodyScrim）；
  • Scaffold.floatingActionButton 会通过 Curves.easeIn 动画缩小，并在底部工作表覆盖整个 Scaffold 时消失。

material/Scaffold-class.html.source: This example shows a Scaffold with a body and FloatingActionButton. The body is a Text placed in a Center in order to center the text within the Scaffold. The FloatingActionButton is connected to a callback that increments a counter.
material/Scaffold-class.html.translation: 此示例展示一个包含 Scaffold、body 和 FloatingActionButton 的界面。body 是放置在 Center 中的 Text，用于让文本在 Scaffold 中居中。FloatingActionButton 关联了一个递增计数器的回调。

material/Scaffold-class.html.source: This example shows a Scaffold with a blueGrey backgroundColor, body and FloatingActionButton. The body is a Text placed in a Center in order to center the text within the Scaffold. The FloatingActionButton is connected to a callback that increments a counter.
material/Scaffold-class.html.translation: 此示例展示一个带有蓝灰色 backgroundColor、body 和 FloatingActionButton 的 Scaffold。body 是放置在 Center 中的 Text，用于让文本在 Scaffold 中居中。FloatingActionButton 关联了一个递增计数器的回调。

material/Scaffold-class.html.source: This example shows a Scaffold with an AppBar, a BottomAppBar and a FloatingActionButton. The body is a Text placed in a Center in order to center the text within the Scaffold. The FloatingActionButton is centered and docked within the BottomAppBar using FloatingActionButtonLocation.centerDocked. The FloatingActionButton is connected to a callback that increments a counter.
material/Scaffold-class.html.translation: 此示例展示一个包含 AppBar、BottomAppBar 和 FloatingActionButton 的 Scaffold。body 是放置在 Center 中的 Text，用于让文本在 Scaffold 中居中。FloatingActionButton 使用 FloatingActionButtonLocation.centerDocked 居中停靠在 BottomAppBar 中，FloatingActionButton 关联了一个递增计数器的回调。

material/Scaffold-class.html.source: Add a listener to the app's tab controller so that the AppBar title of the app's one and only scaffold is reset each time a new tab is selected.
material/Scaffold-class.html.translation: 为应用的标签控制器添加监听器，使得每次选择新标签时，都重置应用中唯一 AppBar 的标题。

material/InputDecoration/prefixIconConst.source: This example shows the differences between two TextField widgets when prefixIconConstraints is set to the default value and when one is not.

material/DropdownMenu/closeBehavior.html.source:
• DropdownMenuCloseBehavior.all: Closes all open menus in the widget tree.
  • DropdownMenuCloseBehavior.self: Closes only the current dropdown menu.
  • DropdownMenuCloseBehavior.none: Does not close any menus.
material/DropdownMenu/closeBehavior.html.translation:
• DropdownMenuCloseBehavior.all: 关闭组件树中所有已打开的菜单。
  • DropdownMenuCloseBehavior.self: 仅关闭当前下拉菜单。

1. Turn on "Don't keep activities", which destroys the Android activity as soon as the user leaves it. This option should become available when Developer Options are turned on for the device.
  2. Run the code sample on an Android device.
  3. Create some in-memory state in the app on the phone, e.g. by navigating to a different screen.

  2. 在 Android 设备上运行代码示例。
  3. 在手机上的应用中创建一些内存状态，例如导航到其他屏幕。
  4. 将 Flutter 应用切换到后台，再返回应用。应用会重新启动并恢复状态。

material/showDatePicker.html.source:
1. Open ios/Runner.xcworkspace/ in Xcode.
  2. (iOS 14+ only): Switch to build in profile or release mode, as launching an app from the home screen is not supported in debug mode.
  3. Press the Play button in Xcode to build and run the app.
  4. Create some in-memory state in the app on the phone, e.g. by navigating to a different screen.
  5. Background the app on the phone, e.g. by going back to the home screen.
  6. Press the Stop button in Xcode to terminate the app while running in the background.
  7. Open the app again on the phone (not via Xcode). It will restart and restore its state.
material/showDatePicker.html.translation:
1. 在 Xcode 中打开 ios/Runner.xcworkspace/。
  2. （仅限 iOS 14 及更高版本）：切换到 profile 或 release 构建模式，因为不支持在 debug 模式下从主屏幕启动应用。
  3. 在 Xcode 中点击播放按钮以构建并运行应用。
  4. 在手机上的应用中创建一些内存状态，例如导航到其他屏幕。
  5. 将应用切换到后台，例如返回手机主屏幕。
  6. 在应用仍处于后台时，点击 Xcode 中的停止按钮终止应用。
  7. 在手机上重新打开应用（不要通过 Xcode 打开）。应用会重新启动并恢复状态。

material/MaterialStateOutlineInputBorder.source:
1. Create a subclass of MaterialStateOutlineInputBorder and implement the abstract resolve method.
  2. Use MaterialStateOutlineInputBorder.resolveWith and pass in a callback that will be used to resolve the color in the given states.
material/MaterialStateOutlineInputBorder.translation:
1. 创建 MaterialStateOutlineInputBorder 的子类，并实现抽象的 resolve 方法。
  2. 使用 MaterialStateOutlineInputBorder.resolveWith，并传入一个回调函数，用于解析给定状态下的颜色。

material/MaterialStateUnderlineInputBord.source:
1. Create a subclass of MaterialStateUnderlineInputBorder and implement the abstract resolve method.
  2. Use MaterialStateUnderlineInputBorder.resolveWith and pass in a callback that will be used to resolve the color in the given states.
material/MaterialStateUnderlineInputBord.translation:
1. 创建 MaterialStateUnderlineInputBorder 的子类，并实现抽象的 resolve 方法。
  2. 使用 MaterialStateUnderlineInputBorder.resolveWith，并传入一个回调函数，用于解析给定状态下的颜色。

material/ProgressIndicatorTheme-class.ht.source: Here is an example of a progress indicator theme that applies a red indicator color.
material/ProgressIndicatorTheme-class.ht.translation: 此示例展示了一个将进度指示器颜色设为红色的主题。

material/TextSelectionTheme-class.html.source: Here is an example of a text selection theme that applies a blue cursor color with light blue selection handles to the child text field.
material/TextSelectionTheme-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了一个文本选择主题：它为子文本字段设置蓝色光标和浅蓝色选择手柄。

material/StepStyle-class.html.source: An example that uses StepStyle to customize the appearance of each Step in a Stepper.
material/StepStyle-class.html.translation: 此示例使用 StepStyle 自定义 Stepper 中每个 Step 的外观。

material/WidgetStateInputBorder-class.ht.source: This example shows how to use WidgetStateInputBorder to create a TextField with an appearance that responds to user interaction.
material/WidgetStateInputBorder-class.ht.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 WidgetStateInputBorder 创建外观可响应用户交互的 TextField。

material/WidgetStateInputBorder-class.ht.source:
1. Creating a class that extends OutlineInputBorder or UnderlineInputBorder and implements WidgetStateInputBorder. The class would also need to override the resolve method.
  2. Using WidgetStateInputBorder.resolveWith with a callback that resolves the input border in the given states.
  3. Using WidgetStateInputBorder.fromMap to assign a border with a WidgetStateMap.
material/WidgetStateInputBorder-class.ht.translation:
1. 创建一个继承 OutlineInputBorder 或 UnderlineInputBorder 并实现 WidgetStateInputBorder 的类。该类还需要重写 resolve 方法。
  2. 使用 WidgetStateInputBorder.resolveWith，并传入一个用于解析给定状态下输入边框的回调函数。
  3. 使用 WidgetStateInputBorder.fromMap，通过 WidgetStateMap 指定边框。

material/MaterialBanner-class.html.source: Banners placed directly into the widget tree are static.
material/MaterialBanner-class.html.translation: 直接放入 widget 树中的横幅是静态的。

material/MaterialBanner-class.html.source: MaterialBanner's can also be presented through a ScaffoldMessenger. Here is an example where ScaffoldMessengerState.showMaterialBanner() is used to show the MaterialBanner.
material/MaterialBanner-class.html.translation: MaterialBanner 也可以通过 ScaffoldMessenger 展示。 以下示例使用 ScaffoldMessengerState.showMaterialBanner() 方法显示 MaterialBanner。

material/InkSparkle-class.html.source: For typical use, pass the InkSparkle.splashFactory to the splashFactory parameter of a button style or ThemeData.
material/InkSparkle-class.html.translation: 通常可将 InkSparkle.splashFactory 传给按钮样式或 ThemeData 的 splashFactory 参数。

material/MenuAcceleratorLabel-class.html.source: This example shows a MenuBar that handles keyboard accelerators using MenuAcceleratorLabel. To use the accelerators, press the Alt key to see which letters are underlined in the menu bar, and then press the appropriate letter. Accelerators are not supported on macOS or iOS since those platforms don't support them natively, so this demo will only show a regular Material menu bar on those platforms.
material/MenuAcceleratorLabel-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了一个可以处理键盘快捷键的 MenuBar，并使用 MenuAcceleratorLabel。要使用这些快捷键，请按 Alt 键查看菜单栏中哪些字母带下划线，然后按对应字母。macOS 和 iOS 原生不支持快捷键，因此在这些平台上，此示例只会显示常规的 Material 菜单栏。

material/MenuAcceleratorLabel-class.html.source: This example shows a MenuBar that handles keyboard accelerators using MenuAcceleratorLabel. To use the accelerators, press the Alt key to see which letters are underlined in the menu bar, and then press the appropriate letter. Accelerators are not supported on macOS or iOS since those platforms don't support them natively, so this demo will only show a regular Material menu bar on those platforms.
material/MenuAcceleratorLabel-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了一个可以处理键盘快捷键的 MenuBar，并使用 MenuAcceleratorLabel。要使用这些快捷键，请按 Alt 键查看菜单栏中哪些字母带下划线，然后按对应字母。macOS 和 iOS 原生不支持快捷键，因此在这些平台上，此示例只会显示常规的 Material 菜单栏。

material/MenuAcceleratorLabel-class.html.source:

flutter create --sample=material.MenuAcceleratorLabel.1 mysample

material/MenuAnchor-class.html.source: This example shows how to use a MenuAnchor to wrap a button and open a cascading menu from the button. This example also shows how to use onAnimationStatusChanged to track animation status and toggle the menu.
material/MenuAnchor-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了如何使用一个 MenuAnchor 包裹按钮，并从按钮打开级联菜单。此示例还演示如何使用 onAnimationStatusChanged 跟踪动画状态并切换菜单。

material/MenuAnchor-class.html.source: This example shows how to use a MenuAnchor to create a cascading context menu in a region of the view, positioned where the user clicks the mouse with Ctrl pressed. The anchorTapClosesMenu attribute is set to true so that clicks on the MenuAnchor area will cause the menus to be closed.
material/MenuAnchor-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了如何使用一个 MenuAnchor 在视图的某个区域创建级联上下文菜单，并将其定位在用户按住 Ctrl 键点击鼠标的位置。 anchorTapClosesMenu 属性设为 true，因此点击 MenuAnchor 区域会关闭菜单。

material/MenuAnchor-class.html.source: This example demonstrates a simplified cascading menu using the MenuAnchor widget.
material/MenuAnchor-class.html.translation: 此示例演示如何使用 MenuAnchor widget。

material/ReorderableListView-class.html.source: While a drag is underway, the widget returned by the ReorderableListView.proxyDecorator callback serves as a "proxy" (a substitute) for the item in the list. The proxy is created with the original list item as its child. The ReorderableListView.proxyDecorator callback in this example is similar to the default one except that it changes the proxy item's background color.
material/ReorderableListView-class.html.translation: 拖动过程中，ReorderableListView.proxyDecorator 回调返回的组件会作为列表项的“代理”（替代项）。代理组件以原列表项为子组件。此示例中的 ReorderableListView.proxyDecorator 回调与默认实现类似，但会更改代理项的背景颜色。

material/ReorderableListView-class.html.source: The default proxyDecorator wraps the dragged item in a Material widget and animates its elevation. This example demonstrates how to use the ReorderableListView.proxyDecorator callback to update the dragged card elevation without inserted a new Material widget.
material/ReorderableListView-class.html.translation: 默认的 proxyDecorator 会将被拖动项包装在 Material 组件中，并为其高度添加动画。此示例展示如何使用 ReorderableListView.proxyDecorator 回调更新被拖动卡片的高度，而不插入新的 Material 组件。

material/TabController-class.html.source: This widget introduces a Scaffold with an AppBar and a TabBar.
material/TabController-class.html.translation: 此示例组件展示了一个带有 AppBar 和 TabBar 的 Scaffold。

material/TabController-class.html.source: This example shows how to listen to page updates in TabBar and TabBarView when using DefaultTabController.
material/TabController-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了使用 DefaultTabController 时，如何监听 TabBar 和 TabBarView 中的页面更新。

  • WidgetState.focused - ColorScheme.onSurface with an opacity of 0.1
material/CarouselView/overlayColor.html.translation:
• WidgetState.pressed - 不透明度为 0.1 的 ColorScheme.onSurface
  • WidgetState.hovered - 不透明度为 0.08 的 ColorScheme.onSurface
  • WidgetState.focused - 不透明度为 0.1 的 ColorScheme.onSurface

It includes both debouncing and error handling, so that failed network requests show an error to the user and can be recovered from. Try toggling the network Switch widget to simulate going offline.
material/Autocomplete-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何创建一个选项通过网络获取的 Autocomplete widget。它同时采用防抖和错误处理，因此网络请求失败时会向用户显示错误，并支持恢复。可以切换网络 Switch widget 来模拟断网。

material/ThemeData-class.html.translation: 此示例展示常见的 MaterialApp 如何指定并使用自定义 Theme。该主题的 ColorScheme 基于一个“种子”颜色，并会根据平台当前的浅色或深色配置进行匹配。该主题还覆盖了 FloatingActionButton 的默认配置，以展示如何自定义一类组件的外观。

material/MaterialRouteTransitionMixin/ad.source:
The following example is an app with 2 pages: HomePage and SecondPage. The HomePage can navigate to the SecondPage.

The SecondPage uses a LocalHistoryEntry to implement local navigation within that page. Pressing 'show rectangle' displays a red rectangle and adds a local history entry. At that point, pressing the '< back' button pops the latest route, which is the local history entry, and the red rectangle disappears. Pressing the '< back' button a second time once again pops the latest route, which is the SecondPage, itself. Therefore, the second press navigates back to the HomePage.
material/MaterialRouteTransitionMixin/ad.translation:
以下示例是一个包含两个页面的应用：HomePage 和 SecondPage。HomePage 可以跳转到 SecondPage。

SecondPage 使用 LocalHistoryEntry 实现页面内的本地导航。按下“显示矩形”后，会显示一个红色矩形并添加本地历史记录条目。此时按“返回”会弹出最新的路由（即本地历史记录条目），红色矩形随之消失。再次按“返回”会弹出最新路由，也就是 SecondPage 本身，因此会返回 HomePage。

material/MaterialRouteTransitionMixin/bu.source:
The following example uses the primary animation to drive a SlideTransition that translates the top of the new route vertically from the bottom of the screen when it is pushed on the Navigator's stack. When the route is popped the SlideTransition translates the route from the top of the screen back to the bottom.

We've used PageRouteBuilder to demonstrate the buildTransitions method here. The body of an override of the buildTransitions method would be defined in the same way.
material/MaterialRouteTransitionMixin/bu.translation:
以下示例使用主动画驱动 SlideTransition，使新路由被推入 Navigator 的栈中时，从屏幕底部垂直滑入。路由弹出时，SlideTransition 则使路由从屏幕顶部滑回底部。

这里使用 PageRouteBuilder 演示 buildTransitions 方法。重写 buildTransitions 时，也可以用相同方式定义方法主体。

material/MaterialRouteTransitionMixin/bu.source: The example below adds a transition that's driven by the secondaryAnimation. When this route disappears because a new route has been pushed on top of it, it translates in the opposite direction of the new route. Likewise when the route is exposed because the topmost route has been popped off.
material/MaterialRouteTransitionMixin/bu.translation: 下面的示例添加了一个由 secondaryAnimation 驱动的过渡。当新路由被推入其上方、使此路由离开屏幕时，此路由会沿新路由的反方向移动。当顶层路由弹出、此路由重新显示时，也会采用相应的过渡。

material/MaterialRouteTransitionMixin/de.translation: 此示例展示一个应用在 MaterialApp.router 中使用与上一示例相同的过渡效果。

material/Scrollbar-class.html.source:
This sample shows an app with two scrollables in the same route. Since by default, there is one PrimaryScrollController per route, and they both have a scroll direction of Axis.vertical, they would both try to attach to that controller on mobile platforms. The Scrollbar cannot support multiple positions attached to the same controller, so one ListView, and its Scrollbar have been provided a unique ScrollController. Desktop platforms do not automatically attach to the PrimaryScrollController, requiring ScrollView.primary to be true instead in order to use the PrimaryScrollController.

Alternatively, a new PrimaryScrollController could be created above one of the ListViews.
material/Scrollbar-class.html.translation:
此示例展示同一路由中包含两个可滚动控件的应用。默认情况下，每个路由都有一个 PrimaryScrollController，且这两个控件的滚动方向都是 Axis.vertical，因此在移动平台上都会尝试连接到该控制器。Scrollbar 不支持同一控制器连接多个位置，所以我们为一个 ListView 及其 Scrollbar 配置了唯一的 ScrollController。桌面平台不会自动连接到 PrimaryScrollController；若要使用它，必须改为将 ScrollView.primary 设为 true。

或者，也可以在其中一个 ListView 上方创建一个新的 PrimaryScrollController。

dart-async/ZoneDelegate-class.html.source: • delegate calls are more efficient, since the implementation knows how to skip zones that would just delegate to their parents.
dart-async/ZoneDelegate-class.html.translation: • 调用委托的效率更高，因为其实现知道如何跳过那些只会将调用继续委托给父 zone 的 zone。

dart-async/Zone/handleUncaughtError.html.source: • Uncaught errors that were thrown in asynchronous callbacks, for example, a throw in the function passed to Timer.run.
dart-async/Zone/handleUncaughtError.html.translation: • 在异步回调中抛出的未捕获错误，例如传递给 Timer.run 的函数中抛出的 throw。

dart-async/Zone/handleUncaughtError.html.source: • Asynchronous errors that are pushed through Future and Stream chains, but for which nobody registered an error handler. Most asynchronous classes, like Future or Stream push errors to their listeners. Errors are propagated this way until either a listener handles the error (for example with Future.catchError), or no listener is available anymore. In the latter case, futures and streams invoke the zone's handleUncaughtError.
dart-async/Zone/handleUncaughtError.html.translation: • 在 Future 和 Stream 链中传递、但无人注册错误处理器的异步错误。大多数异步类（如 Future 或 Stream）会将错误传递给侦听器。错误会一直这样传播，直到某个侦听器处理错误（例如使用 Future.catchError），或不再有可用的侦听器。后一种情况下，future 和 stream 会调用 zone 的 handleUncaughtError。

dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.source: • If the event is an error event or a done event, it is emitted directly by the returned stream.
dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.translation: • 如果该事件是错误事件或完成事件，则由返回的数据流直接发出。

dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.source: • Otherwise it is an element. Then the convert function is called with the element as argument to produce a convert-stream for the element.
dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.translation: • 否则，该事件就是一个元素。随后会调用 convert 函数，并将该元素作为参数传入，为此元素生成一个转换数据流。

dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.source: • If that call throws, the error is emitted on the returned stream.
dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.translation: • 如果调用该函数时抛出异常，则由返回的数据流发出该错误。

dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.source: • If the call returns null, no further action is taken for the elements.
dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.translation: • 如果调用结果为 null，则不再对该元素执行其他操作。

dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.source: • Otherwise, this stream is paused and convert-stream is listened to. Every data and error event of the convert-stream is emitted on the returned stream in the order it is produced. When the convert-stream ends, this stream is resumed.
dart-async/Stream/asyncExpand.html.translation: • 否则，当前数据流会暂停，并开始侦听转换数据流。转换数据流产生的每个数据事件和错误事件都会按产生顺序由返回的数据流发出。转换数据流结束后，当前数据流会恢复。

dart-async/StreamTransformer/bind.html.source: • When the returned stream is listened to, it starts listening to the input stream.
dart-async/StreamTransformer/bind.html.translation: • 侦听返回的数据流时，会开始侦听输入的 stream。

dart-async/StreamTransformer/bind.html.source: • Subscriptions of the returned stream forward (in a reasonable time) a StreamSubscription.pause call to the subscription of the input stream.
dart-async/StreamTransformer/bind.html.translation: • 在合理的时间内，返回数据流的订阅会将 StreamSubscription.pause 调用转发给输入 stream 的订阅。

dart-async/StreamTransformer/bind.html.source: • Similarly, canceling a subscription of the returned stream eventually (in reasonable time) cancels the subscription of the input stream.
dart-async/StreamTransformer/bind.html.translation: • 类似地，取消返回数据流的订阅后，会在合理的时间内取消输入 stream 的订阅。

physics/GravitySimulation-class.html.source: This method triggers an AnimationController (a previously constructed _controller field) to simulate a fall of 300 pixels.
physics/GravitySimulation-class.html.translation: 此方法会触发 AnimationController（一个此前已创建的 _controller 字段），以模拟下落 300 像素。

physics/SpringSimulation-class.html.source: This method triggers an AnimationController (a previously constructed _controller field) to simulate a spring oscillation.
physics/SpringSimulation-class.html.translation: 此方法会触发 AnimationController（一个此前已创建的 _controller 字段），以模拟弹簧振荡。

package-async_async/SingleSubscriptionTr.source: • When the returned stream is listened to, it starts listening to the input stream.
package-async_async/SingleSubscriptionTr.translation: • 有人开始监听返回的流时，转换器就会开始监听输入 stream。

package-async_async/SingleSubscriptionTr.source: • Subscriptions of the returned stream forward (in a reasonable time) a StreamSubscription.pause call to the subscription of the input stream.
package-async_async/SingleSubscriptionTr.translation: • 返回流的订阅会在合理时间内，将 StreamSubscription.pause 调用转发给输入 stream 的订阅。

package-async_async/SingleSubscriptionTr.source: • Similarly, canceling a subscription of the returned stream eventually (in reasonable time) cancels the subscription of the input stream.
package-async_async/SingleSubscriptionTr.translation: • 同样，取消返回流的订阅后，输入 stream 的订阅最终也会被取消（在合理时间内）。

package-async_async/StreamCloser/bind.ht.source: • When the returned stream is listened to, it starts listening to the input stream.
package-async_async/StreamCloser/bind.ht.translation: • 有人开始监听返回的流时，转换器就会开始监听输入 stream。

package-async_async/StreamCloser/bind.ht.source: • Subscriptions of the returned stream forward (in a reasonable time) a StreamSubscription.pause call to the subscription of the input stream.
package-async_async/StreamCloser/bind.ht.translation: • 返回流的订阅会在合理时间内，将 StreamSubscription.pause 调用转发给输入 stream 的订阅。

package-async_async/StreamCloser/bind.ht.source: • Similarly, canceling a subscription of the returned stream eventually (in reasonable time) cancels the subscription of the input stream.
package-async_async/StreamCloser/bind.ht.translation: • 同样，取消返回流的订阅后，输入 stream 的订阅最终也会被取消（在合理时间内）。

package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.source: • This group is idle and close has been called, or
package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.translation: • 此组处于空闲状态且已调用 close；或者

package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.source: • stream's subscription has been cancelled (if this is a single-subscription group).
package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.translation: • 已取消 stream 的订阅（如果这是单订阅组）。

package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.source: • Events won't be emitted on this stream until stream has been listened to.
package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.translation: • 有人开始监听 stream 之前，此流不会发出事件。

package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.source: • Events are delivered asynchronously, so it's possible for the group to become active again before the event is delivered.
package-async_async/StreamGroup/onIdle.h.translation: • 事件会异步传递，因此事件送达前，此组可能已经重新变为活动状态。

package-async_async/StreamSinkBase/done..source: • all events have been processed and the sink has been closed, or
package-async_async/StreamSinkBase/done..translation: • 所有事件都已处理完毕，且接收器已关闭；或者

package-async_async/StreamSinkBase/done..source: • the sink has otherwise been stopped from handling more events (for example by canceling a stream subscription).
package-async_async/StreamSinkBase/done..translation: • 接收器已因其他原因停止处理更多事件（例如，流订阅已取消）。

foundation/BindingBase-class.html.source: • The initInstances method, which must call super.initInstances and set an _instance static field to this.
foundation/BindingBase-class.html.translation: • initInstances 方法：必须调用 super.initInstances，并将静态字段 _instance 设为 this。

foundation/BindingBase-class.html.source: • An instance static getter, which must return that field using checkInstance.
foundation/BindingBase-class.html.translation: • instance 静态 getter：必须通过 checkInstance 返回该字段。

cupertino/CupertinoDatePicker/selectionO.source: This example shows how to recreate the default selection overlay with selectionOverlayBuilder.
cupertino/CupertinoDatePicker/selectionO.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 selectionOverlayBuilder 重新创建默认的选择覆盖层。

cupertino/CupertinoDatePicker-class.html.source:
This sample shows how to implement CupertinoDatePicker with different picker modes.
We can provide initial dateTime value for the picker to display. When user changes
the drag the date or time wheels, the picker will call onDateTimeChanged callback.
cupertino/CupertinoDatePicker-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何通过不同的选择器模式实现 CupertinoDatePicker。可以为选择器提供要显示的初始日期时间值。用户拖动日期或时间滚轮进行更改时，选择器会调用 onDateTimeChanged 回调。

cupertino/CupertinoDatePicker-class.html.source: CupertinoDatePicker can be displayed directly on a screen or in a popup.
cupertino/CupertinoDatePicker-class.html.translation: CupertinoDatePicker 可以直接显示在屏幕上，也可以显示在弹出窗口中。

cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor/darkColo.source: • has a CupertinoTheme whose CupertinoThemeData.brightness is Brightness.dark, or a MediaQuery whose MediaQueryData.platformBrightness is Brightness.dark.
cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor/darkColo.translation: • 具有一个 CupertinoTheme，其 CupertinoThemeData.brightness 为 Brightness.dark；或者具有一个 MediaQuery，其 MediaQueryData.platformBrightness 为 Brightness.dark。

cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor/highCont.source: • has a CupertinoTheme whose CupertinoThemeData.brightness is Brightness.light, or a MediaQuery whose MediaQueryData.platformBrightness is Brightness.light.
cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor/highCont.translation: • 具有一个 CupertinoTheme，其 CupertinoThemeData.brightness 为 Brightness.light；或者具有一个 MediaQuery，其 MediaQueryData.platformBrightness 为 Brightness.light。

cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor/highCont.source: • has a CupertinoTheme whose CupertinoThemeData.brightness is Brightness.light, or a MediaQuery whose MediaQueryData.platformBrightness is Brightness.light.
cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor/highCont.translation: • 具有一个 CupertinoTheme，其 CupertinoThemeData.brightness 为 Brightness.light；或者具有一个 MediaQuery，其 MediaQueryData.platformBrightness 为 Brightness.light。
• 具有一个 CupertinoUserInterfaceLevel，其表示的界面层级为 CupertinoUserInterfaceLevelData.elevated。

cupertino/CupertinoExpansionTile-class.h.source: This example shows how to use CupertinoExpansionTile with different transition modes.
cupertino/CupertinoExpansionTile-class.h.translation: 此示例展示如何使用不同的转场模式配置 CupertinoExpansionTile。

cupertino/CupertinoFormRow-class.html.source: Creates a CupertinoFormSection containing a CupertinoFormRow with prefix, child, helper and error specified.
cupertino/CupertinoFormRow-class.html.translation: 创建一个 CupertinoFormSection，其中包含一个指定了 prefix、child、helper 和 error 的 CupertinoFormRow。

cupertino/CupertinoLinearActivityIndicat.source: This example shows how CupertinoLinearActivityIndicator can be customized.
cupertino/CupertinoLinearActivityIndicat.translation: 此示例展示如何自定义 CupertinoLinearActivityIndicator。

cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.source: Pages will be dismissible via a back swipe.
cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.translation: 通过向后滑动即可关闭页面。

cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.source: Scrolling past extremities will trigger iOS-style spring overscrolls.
cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.translation: 滚动越过边界时会触发 iOS 风格的弹性过滚效果。

cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.source:
The San Francisco font family is unavailable on Android and can result
in undefined font behavior.
cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.translation: Android 上无法使用 San Francisco 字体系列，因此字体显示行为可能无法确定。

cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.source: This example shows how to create a CupertinoApp that disables the "debug" banner with a home route that will be displayed when the app is launched.
cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何创建一个关闭“debug”横幅的 CupertinoApp，并设置应用启动时显示的 home 路由。

cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.source: This example shows how to create a CupertinoApp that uses the routes Map to define the "home" route and an "about" route.
cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何创建一个 CupertinoApp，并使用 routes Map 定义“home”和“about”路由。

cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.source: This example shows how to create a CupertinoApp that defines a theme that will be used for Cupertino widgets in the app.
cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何创建一个为应用中的 Cupertino 组件定义 theme 的 CupertinoApp。

cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.source: alt="The CupertinoApp displays a CupertinoPageScaffold with orange-colored icons"
cupertino/CupertinoApp-class.html.translation: alt="CupertinoApp 显示带橙色图标的 CupertinoPageScaffold"

cupertino/CupertinoTabScaffold-class.htm.source: A sample code implementing a typical iOS information architecture with tabs.
cupertino/CupertinoTabScaffold-class.htm.translation: 示例代码展示了典型的 iOS 标签式信息架构。

cupertino/CupertinoTabBar-class.html.source: This example shows a CupertinoTabBar placed in a CupertinoTabScaffold.
cupertino/CupertinoTabBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了在 CupertinoTabScaffold 中放置 CupertinoTabBar。

cupertino/CupertinoTabController-class.h.source: This samples shows how CupertinoTabController can be used to switch tabs in CupertinoTabScaffold.
cupertino/CupertinoTabController-class.h.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 CupertinoTabController 切换 CupertinoTabScaffold 中的标签。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • Let the user draw inside the overscrolled area via the passed in builder.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • 允许用户通过传入的 builder 在过度滚动区域中绘制内容。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • Trigger the provided onRefresh function when overscrolled far enough to pass refreshTriggerPullDistance.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • 过度滚动距离超过 refreshTriggerPullDistance 时，触发所提供的 onRefresh 函数。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • Continue to hold refreshIndicatorExtent amount of space for the builder to keep drawing inside of as the Future returned by onRefresh processes.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • 在 onRefresh 返回的 Future 执行期间，持续保留 refreshIndicatorExtent 指定的空间，供 builder 继续在其中绘制内容。
• onRefresh 返回的 Future 完成后，组件会随滚动移出。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • Providing a BouncingScrollPhysics (possibly in combination with a AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics) while constructing the scrollable.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • 构建滚动组件时，为其提供 BouncingScrollPhysics（也可以与 AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics 组合使用）。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • By inserting a ScrollConfiguration with BouncingScrollPhysics above the scrollable.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • 在滚动组件上方插入一个配置了 BouncingScrollPhysics 的 ScrollConfiguration。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • By using CupertinoApp, which always uses a ScrollConfiguration with BouncingScrollPhysics regardless of platform.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • 使用 CupertinoApp；它无论运行在哪个平台，都会使用配置了 BouncingScrollPhysics 的 ScrollConfiguration。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • CustomScrollView, a typical sliver holding scroll view this control should go into.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • CustomScrollView 是承载 sliver 的典型滚动视图，此控件通常应放入其中。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: • RefreshIndicator, a Material Design version of the pull-to-refresh paradigm. This widget works differently than RefreshIndicator because instead of being an overlay on top of the scrollable, the CupertinoSliverRefreshControl is part of the scrollable and actively occupies scrollable space.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: • RefreshIndicator 是 Material Design 风格的下拉刷新实现。它与 RefreshIndicator 的工作方式不同：后者覆盖在滚动视图上方，而 CupertinoSliverRefreshControl 是滚动视图的一部分，并会实际占用滚动空间。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.source: When the user scrolls past refreshTriggerPullDistance, this sample shows the default iOS pull to refresh indicator for 1 second and adds a new item to the top of the list view.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverRefreshControl-.translation: 当用户滚动超过 refreshTriggerPullDistance 后，此示例会显示默认的 iOS 下拉刷新指示器 1 秒，并在列表顶部添加一项。

cupertino/CupertinoListTile-class.html.source: This example uses a ListView to demonstrate different configurations of CupertinoListTiles.
cupertino/CupertinoListTile-class.html.translation: 此示例使用 ListView 展示 CupertinoListTile 的不同配置。

cupertino/CupertinoNavigationBar-class.h.source: This example shows a CupertinoNavigationBar placed in a CupertinoPageScaffold. Since backgroundColor's opacity is not 1.0, there is a blur effect and content slides underneath.
cupertino/CupertinoNavigationBar-class.h.translation: 此示例展示了在 CupertinoPageScaffold 中放置 CupertinoNavigationBar。由于 backgroundColor 的不透明度不为 1.0，因此会产生模糊效果，内容也会滑到导航栏下方。

cupertino/CupertinoNavigationBar-class.h.source: This example shows the resulting layout from CupertinoNavigationBar.large constructor, showing a large title similar to the expanded state of CupertinoSliverNavigationBar.
cupertino/CupertinoNavigationBar-class.h.translation: 此示例展示使用 CupertinoNavigationBar.large 构造函数得到的布局，其中的大标题类似于展开状态的 CupertinoSliverNavigationBar。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverNavigationBar-c.source: This example shows CupertinoSliverNavigationBar in action inside a CustomScrollView.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverNavigationBar-c.translation: 此示例展示如何在 CupertinoSliverNavigationBar 中使用 CustomScrollView。

cupertino/CupertinoSliverNavigationBar-c.source: To add a widget to the bottom of the nav bar, wrap it with PreferredSize and provide its fully extended size.
cupertino/CupertinoSliverNavigationBar-c.translation: 若要在导航栏底部添加 widget，请使用 PreferredSize 包装它，并提供其完全展开时的尺寸。

cupertino/CupertinoMagnifier-class.html.source: This sample demonstrates how to use CupertinoMagnifier.
cupertino/CupertinoMagnifier-class.html.translation: 此示例演示如何使用 CupertinoMagnifier。

cupertino/CupertinoAlertDialog-class.htm.source: This sample shows how to use a CupertinoAlertDialog. The CupertinoAlertDialog shows an alert with a set of two choices when CupertinoButton is pressed.
cupertino/CupertinoAlertDialog-class.htm.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 CupertinoAlertDialog。 点击 CupertinoButton 时，CupertinoAlertDialog 会显示包含两个选项的警告对话框。

cupertino/CupertinoPageScaffold-class.ht.source: This example shows a CupertinoPageScaffold with a Center as a child. The CupertinoButton is connected to a callback that increments a counter. The backgroundColor can be changed.
cupertino/CupertinoPageScaffold-class.ht.translation: 此示例展示 CupertinoPageScaffold，其中 Center 是 child。 CupertinoButton 连接到一个会递增计数器的回调。 可以更改 backgroundColor。

cupertino/CupertinoSlider-class.html.source: This example shows how to show the current slider value as it changes.
cupertino/CupertinoSlider-class.html.translation: 此示例演示如何在滑块值变化时显示当前值。

cupertino/CupertinoPopupSurface-class.ht.source: This sample shows how to use a CupertinoPopupSurface. The CupertinoPopupSurface shows a modal popup from the bottom of the screen. Toggle the switch to configure its surface color.
cupertino/CupertinoPopupSurface-class.ht.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 CupertinoPopupSurface。CupertinoPopupSurface 会从屏幕底部显示模态弹出层。 切换开关可设置其表面颜色。

cupertino/CupertinoSwitch-class.html.source: This example shows a toggleable CupertinoSwitch. When the thumb slides to the other side of the track, the switch is toggled between on/off.
cupertino/CupertinoSwitch-class.html.translation: 此示例展示可切换的 CupertinoSwitch。滑块移到轨道另一侧时，开关会在开启和关闭状态之间切换。

cupertino/CupertinoSwitch-class.html.source: This sample shows how to use a CupertinoSwitch in a CupertinoListTile. The MergeSemantics is used to turn the entire CupertinoListTile into a single item for accessibility tools.
cupertino/CupertinoSwitch-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 CupertinoSwitch，并将其放在 CupertinoListTile 中。通过 MergeSemantics，辅助功能工具会将整个 CupertinoListTile 视为一个项目。

cupertino/CupertinoButton-class.html.source: This sample shows produces an enabled and disabled CupertinoButton and CupertinoButton.filled.
cupertino/CupertinoButton-class.html.translation: 此示例展示已启用和已禁用状态的 CupertinoButton，以及 CupertinoButton.filled。

cupertino/CupertinoCheckbox-class.html.source: This example shows a toggleable CupertinoCheckbox.
cupertino/CupertinoCheckbox-class.html.translation: 此示例展示可切换的 CupertinoCheckbox。

cupertino/CupertinoCheckbox-class.html.source: • On desktop devices, the tap target matches the visual size.
cupertino/CupertinoCheckbox-class.html.translation: • 在桌面设备上，点击区域与视觉尺寸相同。

cupertino/CupertinoCheckbox-class.html.source: • On mobile devices, the tap target expands to a square of kMinInteractiveDimensionCupertino pixels to meet accessibility guidelines.
cupertino/CupertinoCheckbox-class.html.translation: • 在移动设备上，点击区域会扩展为边长为 kMinInteractiveDimensionCupertino 像素的正方形，以符合无障碍指南。

cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor-class.ht.source: By default a CupertinoButton has no background color. The following sample code shows how to build a CupertinoButton that appears white in light mode, and changes automatically to black in dark mode.

cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor-class.ht.source: The following code sample creates a Container with the primaryColor of the current theme. If primaryColor is a CupertinoDynamicColor, the container will be adaptive, thanks to CupertinoTheme.of: it will switch to primaryColor's dark variant once dark mode is turned on, and turns to primaryColor`'s high contrast variant when MediaQueryData.highContrast is requested in the ambient MediaQuery, etc.
cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor-class.ht.translation: 下面的代码示例使用当前主题的 primaryColor 创建一个 Container。如果 primaryColor 是 CupertinoDynamicColor，多亏了 CupertinoTheme.of，容器会自动适配：开启深色模式后切换为 primaryColor 的深色变体；当环境中的 MediaQueryData.highContrast 请求 MediaQuery 时，则切换为 primaryColor 的高对比度变体，等等。

cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor-class.ht.source: The following code samples demonstrate two cases where you have to manually resolve a CupertinoDynamicColor.
cupertino/CupertinoDynamicColor-class.ht.translation: 以下代码示例展示了必须手动解析 CupertinoDynamicColor 的两种情况。

flutter/widgets/EditableTextTapUpOutside.source:
A common requirement is to unfocus text fields when the user taps outside of it. For UX reasons, it's often desirable to only unfocus when the user taps outside of the text field, but not when they scroll.

To achieve this, you can override the default behavior of EditableTextTapOutsideIntent and EditableTextTapUpOutsideIntent to check the difference in distance between the pointer down and pointer up events before potentially unfocusing.
flutter/widgets/EditableTextTapUpOutside.translation:
一种常见需求是：用户轻触文本字段外部时取消文本字段焦点。出于用户体验考虑，通常只希望在用户轻触字段外部时取消焦点，而在滚动时不取消。

为此，可以重写 EditableTextTapOutsideIntent 和 EditableTextTapUpOutsideIntent 的默认行为，在决定是否取消焦点前，检查指针按下与抬起事件之间的距离差。

flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.source: • The framework creates an element by calling Widget.createElement on the widget that will be used as the element's initial configuration.
flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.translation: • 框架会对用作 element 初始配置的 widget 调用 Widget.createElement，以创建 element。

flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.source: • The framework calls mount to add the newly created element to the tree at a given slot in a given parent. The mount method is responsible for inflating any child widgets and calling attachRenderObject as necessary to attach any associated render objects to the render tree.
flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.translation: • 框架会调用 mount，在指定父级的指定插槽中将新创建的 element 添加到树中。mount 方法负责扩充所有子 widget，并在必要时调用 attachRenderObject，将相关渲染对象附加到渲染树。

flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.source: • At this point, the element is considered "active" and might appear on screen.
flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.translation: • 此时，该 element 被视为“活动”状态，并可能显示在屏幕上。

flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.source: • At some point, the parent might decide to change the widget used to configure this element, for example because the parent rebuilt with new state. When this happens, the framework will call update with the new widget. The new widget will always have the same runtimeType and key as old widget. If the parent wishes to change the runtimeType or key of the widget at this location in the tree, it can do so by unmounting this element and inflating the new widget at this location.
flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.translation: • 之后，父级可能决定更改用于配置此 element 的 widget，例如父级以新状态重新构建时。此时，框架会使用新的 widget 调用 update。新旧 widget 的 runtimeType 和 key 始终相同。如果父级希望更改树中此位置上 widget 的 runtimeType 或 key，可以先卸载此 element，再在此位置扩充新的 widget。

flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.source: • At some point, an ancestor might decide to remove this element (or an intermediate ancestor) from the tree, which the ancestor does by calling deactivateChild on itself. Deactivating the intermediate ancestor will remove that element's render object from the render tree and add this element to the owner's list of inactive elements, causing the framework to call deactivate on this element.
flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.translation: • 之后，某个祖先可能决定从树中移除此 element（或其中间祖先），祖先会通过对自身调用 deactivateChild 来完成此操作。停用中间祖先会从渲染树中移除该 element 的渲染对象，并将此 element 添加到 owner 的非活动 element 列表中，从而使框架对该 element 调用 deactivate。

flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.source: • At this point, the element is considered "inactive" and will not appear on screen. An element can remain in the inactive state only until the end of the current animation frame. At the end of the animation frame, any elements that are still inactive will be unmounted.
flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.translation: • 此时，该 element 被视为“非活动”状态，不会显示在屏幕上。element 只能保持非活动状态直到当前动画帧结束。动画帧结束时，所有仍处于非活动状态的 element 都会被卸载。

flutter/widgets/Element-class.html.source: • If the element gets reincorporated into the tree (e.g., because it or one of its ancestors has a global key that is reused), the framework will remove the element from the owner's list of inactive elements, call activate on the element, and reattach the element's render object to the render tree. (At this point, the element is again considered "active" and might appear on screen.)

widgets/Flex-class.html.source: • Layout each child with a null or zero flex factor (e.g., those that are not Expanded) with unbounded main axis constraints and the incoming cross axis constraints. If the crossAxisAlignment is CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, instead use tight cross axis constraints that match the incoming max extent in the cross axis.
widgets/Flex-class.html.translation: • 使用主轴无界约束和传入的交叉轴约束，对每个 flex 因子为 null 或零的子项进行布局（例如未使用 Expanded 的子项）。如果 crossAxisAlignment 为 CrossAxisAlignment.stretch，则改用紧约束，使交叉轴约束与传入的交叉轴最大范围一致。

widgets/Flex-class.html.source: • Divide the remaining main axis space among the children with non-zero flex factors (e.g., those that are Expanded) according to their flex factor. For example, a child with a flex factor of 2.0 will receive twice the amount of main axis space as a child with a flex factor of 1.0.
widgets/Flex-class.html.translation: • 根据 flex 因子，将主轴剩余空间分配给 flex 因子非零的子项（例如使用 Expanded 的子项）。例如，flex 因子为 2.0 的子项获得的主轴空间是因子为 1.0 子项的两倍。

widgets/Flex-class.html.source: • Layout each of the remaining children with the same cross axis constraints as in step 1, but instead of using unbounded main axis constraints, use max axis constraints based on the amount of space allocated in step 2. Children with Flexible.fit properties that are FlexFit.tight are given tight constraints (i.e., forced to fill the allocated space), and children with Flexible.fit properties that are FlexFit.loose are given loose constraints (i.e., not forced to fill the allocated space).
widgets/Flex-class.html.translation: • 使用与步骤 1 相同的交叉轴约束布局其余子项，但不再使用无界主轴约束，而是根据步骤 2 分配的空间设置主轴最大约束。Flexible.fit 为 FlexFit.tight 的子项会受到紧约束（即必须填满所分配空间）；为 Flexible.fit 属性为 FlexFit.loose 的子项则受到松约束（即不必填满所分配空间）。

widgets/Flex-class.html.source: • The cross axis extent of the Flex is the maximum cross axis extent of the children (which will always satisfy the incoming constraints).
widgets/Flex-class.html.translation: • Flex 的交叉轴范围取子项交叉轴范围的最大值（这始终满足传入的约束）。

widgets/Flex-class.html.source: • The main axis extent of the Flex is determined by the mainAxisSize property. If the mainAxisSize property is MainAxisSize.max, then the main axis extent of the Flex is the max extent of the incoming main axis constraints. If the mainAxisSize property is MainAxisSize.min, then the main axis extent of the Flex is the sum of the main axis extents of the children (subject to the incoming constraints).
widgets/Flex-class.html.translation: • Flex 的主轴范围由 mainAxisSize 属性决定。如果 mainAxisSize 属性为 MainAxisSize.max，则 Flex 的主轴范围为传入主轴约束的最大范围。如果 mainAxisSize 属性为 MainAxisSize.min，则 Flex 的主轴范围为子项主轴范围之和（但仍受传入约束限制）。

widgets/Flex-class.html.source: • Determine the position for each child according to the mainAxisAlignment and the crossAxisAlignment. For example, if the mainAxisAlignment is MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween, any main axis space that has not been allocated to children is divided evenly and placed between the children.
widgets/Flex-class.html.translation: • 根据 mainAxisAlignment 和 crossAxisAlignment 确定每个子项的位置。例如，当 mainAxisAlignment 为 MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween 时，未分配给子项的主轴空间会均匀分配并放置在子项之间。

dart-io/Directory/delete.html.source: • If path corresponds to an empty directory, then that directory is deleted. If path corresponds to a link, and that link resolves to a directory, then the link at path will be deleted. In all other cases, delete completes with a FileSystemException.
dart-io/Directory/delete.html.translation: • 如果 path 对应一个空目录，则删除该目录。如果 path 对应一个链接，且该链接指向目录，则删除 path 处的链接。其他情况下，delete 会以 FileSystemException 完成。

dart-io/Directory/delete.html.source: • The FileSystemEntity at path is deleted regardless of type. If path corresponds to a file or link, then that file or link is deleted. If path corresponds to a directory, then it and all sub-directories and files in those directories are deleted. Links are not followed when deleting recursively. Only the link is deleted, not its target. This behavior allows delete to be used to unconditionally delete any file system object.
dart-io/Directory/delete.html.translation: • 无论类型如何，都会删除 FileSystemEntity 在 path 处对应的实体。如果 path 对应文件或链接，则删除该文件或链接。如果 path 对应目录，则删除该目录以及其中所有子目录和文件。递归删除时不会跟随链接，只删除链接本身，不删除其目标。这样就可以使用 delete 无条件删除任何文件系统对象。

dart-ui/FontFeature/FontFeature.alternat.source: The Raleway font supports several alternate glyphs. The code below shows how specific glyphs can be selected. With aalt set to zero, the default, the normal glyphs are used. With a non-zero value, Raleway substitutes small caps for lower case letters. With value 2, the lowercase "a" changes to a stemless "a", whereas the lowercase "t" changes to a vertical bar instead of having a curve. By targeting specific letters in the text (using widgets.Text.rich), the desired rendering for each glyph can be achieved.
dart-ui/FontFeature/FontFeature.alternat.translation: Raleway 字体支持多种替代字形。以下代码展示了如何选择特定字形。将 aalt 设为默认值 0 时，会使用常规字形。设为非零值时，Raleway 会将小写字母替换为小型大写字母。设为 2 时，小写字母“a”会变为没有竖干的“ɑ”，而小写字母“t”会变为竖线，不再带有弧形。通过指定文本中的具体字母（使用 widgets.Text.rich），即可为每个字形实现所需的呈现效果。

dart-ui/FontFeature/FontFeature.caseSens.source: The Piazzolla font supports the case feature. It causes parentheses, brackets, braces, guillemets, slashes, bullets, and some other glyphs (not shown below) to be shifted up slightly so that capital letters appear centered in comparison. When the feature is disabled, those glyphs are optimized for use with lowercase letters, and so capital letters appear to ride higher relative to the punctuation marks.
dart-ui/FontFeature/FontFeature.caseSens.translation: Piazzolla 字体支持 case 特性。此特性会将圆括号、方括号、花括号、书名号、斜线、项目符号以及其他一些（下方未展示的）字形略微上移，使大写字母与它们相比看起来居中。禁用此特性时，这些字形会针对小写字母进行优化，因此大写字母相对于标点符号看起来会更高。

flutter_gpu/PixelFormat.html.source:
• r, g, b: the red, green, and blue color components.
  • a: the alpha component.
  • d: the depth component.
  • s: the stencil component.
  • UNorm: an unsigned integer that is mapped from the range [0, 2^bits - 1] onto the floating point range [0.0, 1.0] when read.
  • UInt: an unsigned integer that is read without normalization.
  • Float: an IEEE 754 floating point value.
  • SRGB: the color components are stored in the sRGB color space and are converted to and from linear space when read and written.
flutter_gpu/PixelFormat.html.translation:
• r、g、b：红、绿、蓝颜色分量。
  • a：透明度分量。
  • d：深度分量。
  • s：模板分量。
  • UNorm：无符号整数；读取时会将其从 [0, 2^bits - 1] 范围映射到浮点数范围 [0.0, 1.0]。
  • UInt：读取时不进行归一化处理的无符号整数。
  • Float：IEEE 754 浮点数。
  • SRGB：颜色分量以 sRGB 色彩空间存储，读写时会在 sRGB 与线性空间之间转换。

painting/StrutStyle-class.html.source:
In this simple case, the text will be rendered at font size 10, however,
the vertical height of each line will be the strut height (Roboto in
font size 30 * 1.5) as the text itself is shorter than the strut.
painting/StrutStyle-class.html.translation: 在这个简单示例中，文本将以 10 号字体渲染；不过，由于文本本身比支架矮，每行的垂直高度将采用文本支架的高度（Roboto 字体大小 30 × 1.5）。

painting/StrutStyle-class.html.source: Here, strut is used to absorb the additional line height in the second line. The strut height was defined as 1.5 (the default font size is 14), which caused all lines to be laid out taller than without strut. This extra space was able to accommodate the larger font size of Second line! without causing the line height to change for the second line only. All lines in this example are thus the same height (14 * 1.5).
painting/StrutStyle-class.html.translation: 这里使用文本支架吸收第二行增加的行高。文本支架的 height 设为 1.5（默认字号为 14），因此所有行的布局高度都比不使用文本支架时更高。额外空间容纳了字号较大的 Second line!，避免只有第二行的行高发生变化。因此，此示例中的所有行高度相同（14 * 1.5）。

painting/StrutStyle-class.html.source: Here, strut is used to enable strange and overlapping text to achieve unique effects. The Ms in lines 2 and 3 are able to extend above their lines and fill empty space in lines above. The forceStrutHeight is enabled and functions as a 'grid' for the glyphs to draw on.
painting/StrutStyle-class.html.translation: 这里使用文本支架让文本产生奇特的重叠效果，从而实现独特的视觉表现。第 2 行和第 3 行中的 M 可以延伸到各自行的上方，填充上方行中的空白。forceStrutHeight 已启用，并作为字形绘制所依循的“网格”。

painting/StrutStyle-class.html.source: This example uses forceStrutHeight to create a 'drop cap' for the 'T' in 'The'. By locking the line heights to the metrics of the 14pt serif font, we are able to lay out a large 37pt 'T' on the second line to take up space on both the first and second lines.
painting/StrutStyle-class.html.translation: 此示例使用 forceStrutHeight 为“The”中的字母“T”创建首字下沉效果。将行高锁定为 14 磅衬线字体的度量值后，就可以在第二行布局一个较大的 37 磅“T”，让它同时占据第一行和第二行的空间。

painting/StrutStyle-class.html.translation:

This sample demonstrates how to run an accessibility guideline in a unit
test against a single screen.
flutter_test/AccessibilityGuideline-clas.translation: 此示例演示如何在单元测试中对单个屏幕运行无障碍指南。

flutter_test/AnimationSheetBuilder-class.source: The following example shows how to record an animation sheet of an InkWell being pressed then released.

flutter_test/AutomatedTestWidgetsFlutter.translation: 按照惯例，如果要将该服务作为单例提供， 应通过 MixinClassName.instance 暴露它。这是一个静态 getter，返回类型不可为 null， 并返回由 initInstances() 设置的静态字段 MixinClassName._instance。为改善开发者体验，实际返回值 应为 BindingBase.checkInstance(_instance)（参见 checkInstance）， 如下面示例所示。
flutter_test/AutomatedTestWidgetsFlutter.source: By convention, if the service is to be provided as a singleton, it should be exposed as MixinClassName.instance, a static getter with a non-nullable return type that returns MixinClassName._instance, a static field that is set by initInstances(). To improve the developer experience, the return value should actually be BindingBase.checkInstance(_instance) (see checkInstance), as in the example below.

  • textContrastGuideline：WCAG 最小文本对比度准则。
  • labeledTapTargetGuideline：确保可点按区域带有标签。

widgets/FormField/forceErrorText.html.source: • InputDecoration.errorText, which is used to display error messages in the text field's decoration without effecting the field's state. When forceErrorText is not null, it will override InputDecoration.errorText value.

widgets/GlobalKey-class.html.translation: • 关于组件如何使用 key 的更多信息，请参阅 Widget.key。

widgets/GlowingOverscrollIndicator-class.source: • OverscrollIndicatorNotification, which can be used to manipulate the glow position or prevent the glow from being painted at all.
widgets/GlowingOverscrollIndicator-class.translation: • OverscrollIndicatorNotification，可用于调整发光位置，或完全阻止绘制发光效果。
• StretchingOverscrollIndicator，一种 Material Design 风格的过度滚动提示。

widgets/GridView-class.html.source: • SingleChildScrollView, which is a scrollable widget that has a single child.
widgets/GridView-class.html.translation: • SingleChildScrollView，一种只有一个子组件的可滚动组件。

widgets/GridView-class.html.source: • ListView, which is scrollable, linear list of widgets.
widgets/GridView-class.html.translation: • ListView，用于线性排列可滚动组件的列表。

widgets/GridView-class.html.source: • PageView, which is a scrolling list of child widgets that are each the size of the viewport.
widgets/GridView-class.html.translation: • PageView，由可滚动子组件组成的列表，每个子组件大小均与视口相同。

widgets/GridView-class.html.source: • CustomScrollView, which is a scrollable widget that creates custom scroll effects using slivers.
widgets/GridView-class.html.translation: • CustomScrollView，使用 sliver 创建自定义滚动效果的可滚动组件。

widgets/GridView-class.html.source: • SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount, which creates a layout with a fixed number of tiles in the cross axis.
widgets/GridView-class.html.translation: • SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount，创建交叉轴上网格项数量固定的布局。

widgets/GridView-class.html.source: • SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent, which creates a layout with tiles that have a maximum cross-axis extent.
widgets/GridView-class.html.translation: • SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent，创建交叉轴范围不超过最大值的网格项布局。

widgets/GridView-class.html.source: • ScrollNotification and NotificationListener, which can be used to watch the scroll position without using a ScrollController.
widgets/GridView-class.html.translation: • ScrollNotification 和 NotificationListener，可用于监听滚动位置，而无需使用 ScrollController。

widgets/Hero-class.html.source: This sample shows a Hero used within a ListTile.
widgets/Hero-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了在 ListTile 中使用 Hero 的方式。

widgets/Hero-class.html.source:
The Hero widget uses the matching tags to identify and execute this
animation.
widgets/Hero-class.html.translation: Hero 组件会使用匹配的标记来识别并执行此动画。

widgets/Hero-class.html.source: This sample shows Hero flight animations using default tween and custom rect tween.
widgets/Hero-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了使用默认补间和自定义矩形补间实现的 Hero 飞行动画。

widgets/ScrollAwareImageProvider-class.h.translation: • 如果返回的 ImageStream 已完成，则结束。这可能是调用方为该流设置了 completer 所致。

widgets/ScrollAwareImageProvider-class.h.source: • If the ImageCache has a completer for the key for this image, ask the wrapped provider to resolve. This can happen if the image was precached, or another ImageProvider already resolved the same image.

widgets/ScrollAwareImageProvider-class.h.source: • If the context has been disposed, end. This can happen if the caller has been disposed and is no longer interested in resolving the image.
widgets/ScrollAwareImageProvider-class.h.translation: • 如果 context 已释放，则结束。这可能是调用方已被释放，不再需要解析该图像。

widgets/ImplicitlyAnimatedWidgetState/fo.source: This sample implements an implicitly animated widget's State. The widget animates between colors whenever widget.targetColor changes.
widgets/ImplicitlyAnimatedWidgetState/fo.translation: 此示例实现了一个隐式动画组件的 State。每当 widget.targetColor 变化时，该组件都会在不同颜色之间播放动画。

widgets/IndexedStack-class.html.source: This example shows a IndexedStack widget being used to lay out one card at a time from a series of cards, each keeping their respective states.
widgets/IndexedStack-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了如何使用 IndexedStack 组件，在一组卡片中每次布局一张卡片，同时保留每张卡片各自的状态。

widgets/IndexedSemantics-class.html.source:
The example below handles spacers in a scrollable that don't contribute
semantics. The automatic indexes would give the spaces a semantic index,
causing scroll announcements to erroneously state that there are four items
visible.
widgets/IndexedSemantics-class.html.translation: 下面的示例处理滚动组件中不提供语义信息的间隔组件。自动生成的索引会为这些间隔分配语义索引，导致滚动播报错误地称当前有四个条目可见。

widgets/InheritedTheme-class.html.source: This example demonstrates how InheritedTheme.capture() can be used to wrap the contents of a new route with the inherited themes that are present when the route was built - but are not present when route is actually shown.
widgets/InheritedTheme-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了如何使用 InheritedTheme.capture()，将路由构建时存在、但实际显示路由时已不在场的继承主题包装到新路由内容外层。

widgets/InheritedTheme-class.html.source:
If the same code is run without `InheritedTheme.capture(), the
new route's Text widget will inherit the "something must be wrong"
fallback text style, rather than the default text style defined in MyApp.
widgets/InheritedTheme-class.html.translation: 如果运行相同代码时不使用 `InheritedTheme.capture()`，新路由中的 Text 组件将继承“something must be wrong”这一备用文本样式，而不是 MyApp 中定义的默认文本样式。

widgets/InteractiveViewer-class.html.source: This example shows a simple Container that can be panned and zoomed.
widgets/InteractiveViewer-class.html.translation: 此示例展示一个可平移和缩放的简单 Container。

widgets/InteractiveViewer/builder.html.source: This example shows how to use builder to create a Table whose cell contents are only built when they are visible. Built and remove cells are logged in the console for illustration.
widgets/InteractiveViewer/builder.html.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 builder 创建 Table，仅在单元格可见时才构建其内容。为便于说明，已构建和已移除的单元格会记录到控制台。

widgets/InteractiveViewer/constrained.ht.source: This example shows how to create a pannable table. Because the table is larger than the entire screen, setting constrained to false is necessary to allow it to be drawn to its full size. The parts of the table that exceed the screen size can then be panned into view.
widgets/InteractiveViewer/constrained.ht.translation: 此示例展示如何创建可平移的表格。由于表格比整个屏幕更大，必须将 constrained 设为 false，才能按完整尺寸绘制表格；超出屏幕的部分随后可通过平移移入视野。

widgets/InteractiveViewer/transformation.source:
This example shows how transformationController can be used to animate the
transformation back to its starting position.
widgets/InteractiveViewer/transformation.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 transformationController 为变换添加动画，使其恢复到初始位置。

widgets/ListView/ListView.custom.html.source: This example shows a ListView that uses a custom SliverChildBuilderDelegate to support child reordering.
widgets/ListView/ListView.custom.html.translation: 此示例展示一个使用自定义 SliverChildBuilderDelegate 来支持子组件重新排序的 ListView。

widgets/ListView/ListView.separated.html.source: This example shows how to create ListView whose ListTile list items are separated by Dividers.
widgets/ListView/ListView.separated.html.translation: 此示例展示如何创建一个 ListView，其中的 ListTile 列表项由 Divider 分隔。

widgets/LayoutBuilder-class.html.source: This example uses a LayoutBuilder to build a different widget depending on the available width. Resize the DartPad window to see LayoutBuilder in action!
widgets/LayoutBuilder-class.html.translation: 此示例使用 LayoutBuilder，根据可用宽度构建不同的组件。调整 DartPad 窗口大小，即可查看 LayoutBuilder 的效果！

widgets/Notification-class.html.source: This example shows a NotificationListener widget that listens for ScrollNotification notifications. When a scroll event occurs in the NestedScrollView, this widget is notified. The events could be either a ScrollStartNotificationorScrollEndNotification.
widgets/Notification-class.html.translation: 此示例展示一个监听 ScrollNotification 通知的 NotificationListener 组件。当 NestedScrollView 中发生滚动事件时，此组件会收到通知。事件可能是 ScrollStartNotification 或 ScrollEndNotification。

widgets/SizeTransition-class.html.source: This code defines a widget that uses SizeTransition to change the size of FlutterLogo continually. It is built with a Scaffold where the internal widget has space to change its size.
widgets/SizeTransition-class.html.translation: 此代码定义了一个 widget，使用 SizeTransition 持续改变 FlutterLogo 的尺寸。它置于 Scaffold 中，内部 widget 有足够空间改变尺寸。
