widgets/SliverAnimatedGrid-class.html.source: This sample application uses a SliverAnimatedGrid to create an animated effect when items are removed or added to the grid.
widgets/SliverAnimatedGrid-class.html.translation: 此示例应用使用 SliverAnimatedGrid 在网格中移除或添加项目时创建动画效果。

widgets/SliverAnimatedList-class.html.source: This sample application uses a SliverAnimatedList to create an animated effect when items are removed or added to the list.
widgets/SliverAnimatedList-class.html.translation: 此示例应用使用 SliverAnimatedList 在列表中移除或添加项目时创建动画效果。

widgets/OverflowBar-class.html.source: This example defines a simple approximation of a dialog layout, where the layout of the dialog's action buttons are defined by an OverflowBar. The content is wrapped in a SingleChildScrollView, so that if overflow occurs, the action buttons will still be accessible by scrolling, no matter how much vertical space is available.
widgets/OverflowBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示了一种简单的对话框布局近似实现，其中对话框操作按钮的布局由 OverflowBar 定义。内容被包裹在 SingleChildScrollView 中，因此即使发生溢出，无论可用垂直空间有多少，仍可通过滚动访问操作按钮。

widgets/OverflowBox-class.html.source: This example shows how an OverflowBox is used, and what its effect is.
widgets/OverflowBox-class.html.translation: 此示例展示 OverflowBox 的用法及其效果。

widgets/Overlay-class.html.source: This example shows how to use the Overlay to highlight the NavigationBar destination.
widgets/Overlay-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 Overlay 突出显示 NavigationBar 的目标项。

widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.source: This example uses an OverlayPortal to build a tooltip that becomes visible when the user taps on the child widget. There's a DefaultTextStyle above the OverlayPortal controlling the TextStyle of both the child widget and the widget overlayChildBuilder builds, which isn't otherwise doable if the tooltip was added as an OverlayEntry.
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.translation: 此示例使用 OverlayPortal 构建提示框，用户点击 child widget 后，提示框便会显示。OverlayPortal 上方有一个 DefaultTextStyle，用于控制 child widget 以及 overlayChildBuilder 所构建 widget 的 TextStyle；如果将提示框作为 OverlayEntry 添加，则无法实现这一点。

widgets/Navigator-class.html.source: The following example demonstrates how a nested Navigator can be used to present a standalone user registration journey.
widgets/Navigator-class.html.translation: 以下示例演示如何使用嵌套的 Navigator 展示独立的用户注册流程。

widgets/Page-class.html.source: This sample demonstrates how to use this canPop and onPopInvoked to intercept pops.
widgets/Page-class.html.translation: 此示例演示如何使用 canPop 和 onPopInvoked 拦截弹出操作。

widgets/Padding-class.html.source: This snippet creates "Hello World!" Text inside a Card that is indented by sixteen pixels in each direction.
widgets/Padding-class.html.translation: 此示例会在 Card 内创建一个四周各缩进十六像素的“Hello World!” Text。

widgets/PageController-class.html.source: This widget introduces a MaterialApp, Scaffold and PageView with two pages using the default constructor. Both pages contain an ElevatedButton allowing you to animate the PageView using a PageController.
widgets/PageController-class.html.translation: 此示例使用默认构造函数创建一个包含 MaterialApp、Scaffold 和 PageView 的组件，并设置两个页面。两个页面都包含一个 ElevatedButton，可用于通过 PageController 为 PageView 添加动画。

widgets/PlatformMenuBar-class.html.source: This example will only work on macOS.
widgets/PlatformMenuBar-class.html.translation: 此示例只能在 macOS 上运行。

widgets/PlatformMenuBar-class.html.source: This example shows a PlatformMenuBar that contains a single top level menu, containing three items for "About", a toggleable menu item for showing a message, a cascading submenu with message choices, and "Quit".
widgets/PlatformMenuBar-class.html.translation: 此示例展示一个 PlatformMenuBar，其中包含一个顶层菜单。该菜单有三个菜单项：“About”、一个用于显示消息的可切换菜单项、一个包含消息选项的级联子菜单，以及“Quit”。

widgets/RadioGroup-class.html.source: Here is an example of RadioGroup widget.
widgets/RadioGroup-class.html.translation: 下面是 RadioGroup 组件示例。

widgets/RadioGroup-class.html.translation: 尝试使用 Tab 键、方向键和空格键，查看组件的响应方式。

widgets/RawAutocomplete-class.html.source: This example shows how to create a very basic autocomplete widget using the fieldViewBuilder and optionsViewBuilder parameters.
widgets/RawAutocomplete-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何使用 fieldViewBuilder 和 optionsViewBuilder 参数创建一个非常基础的自动补全组件。

widgets/RawAutocomplete-class.html.source:
This example is similar to the previous example, but it uses a custom T data

widgets/RawAutocomplete-class.html.translation: 此示例与前一个示例类似，但使用自定义 T 数据类型，而不是直接使用 String。

widgets/RawAutocomplete-class.html.source: This example shows the use of RawAutocomplete in a form.
widgets/RawAutocomplete-class.html.translation: 此示例展示如何在表单中使用 RawAutocomplete。

widgets/RawAutocomplete/focusNode.html.translation: 此示例展示如何创建自动补全组件，将文本字段放在 AppBar 中，并将结果显示在应用主体中。

widgets/RawAutocomplete/textEditingContr.source:

flutter/widgets/Text-class.html.source:
Setting maxLines to 1 is not equivalent to disabling soft wrapping with softWrap. This is apparent when using TextOverflow.fade as the following examples show.

Here soft wrapping is enabled and the Text widget tries to wrap the words "how are you?" to a second line. This is prevented by the maxLines value of 1. The result is that a second line overflows and the fade appears in a horizontal direction at the bottom.

Here soft wrapping is disabled with softWrap: false and the Text widget attempts to display its text in a single unbroken line. The result is that the single line overflows and the fade appears in a vertical direction at the right.
flutter/widgets/Text-class.html.translation:
将 maxLines 设为 1 并不等同于通过 softWrap 禁用软换行。使用 TextOverflow.fade 时，以下示例可以说明这一点。

此处启用了软换行，Text widget 会尝试将“how are you?”换到第二行。maxLines 的值为 1，因此无法换行。结果是第二行发生溢出，底部出现水平渐隐效果。

此处通过 softWrap: false 禁用了软换行，Text widget 会尝试将文本显示在一条不断开的行中。结果是该行发生溢出，并在右侧出现垂直渐隐效果。
